decisions.reason: As a dental consumable that fits the firm's laboratory workflow business, it is still worth keeping, but after several years with no clear web visibility the value of waiting is lower than in 2019.
This thermoforming blank remains closely aligned with the firm's materials portfolio and is likely inexpensive to carry, so management would keep it unless sales evidence has clearly disappointed.

After multiple years, the niche intraoral contrast spray appears to have delivered enough information, and the lack of continued visibility makes reallocation of resources more likely than further waiting.
Custom earmolds are strongly tied to the firm's hearing-care capabilities, custom manufacturing base, and specialist channels, so this remains a strategically coherent product line to retain.

Hearing protection earmolds are a narrower option than core earmolds, but they still leverage the same custom production and channel strengths, making continued retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.
